exposure: ABO blood type (A, B, O, AB)
cohort: The study included 1678 participants with clinically confirmed placenta previa from a university-based tertiary medical center between January 1, 2014, and June 30, 2019.
finding: Type AB blood was associated with a higher incidence of antepartum hemorrhage, predelivery anemia, and preterm birth in women with placenta previa.
